instructions_to_main_agent: 2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
3. THEME: Implement the 'Academic Blue' and 'Vibrant Coral' colors in tailwind.config.js.
4. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn for complex interactive elements (Dialog, Form, Select) but style them with the 'rounded-xl' and 'border-slate-200' aesthetic.
5. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs. DO NOT use placeholders.
6. MOTION: Apply 'hover:-translate-y-1' to all cards. Use framer-motion for page transitions.
7. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure text contrast is high. Use 'text-slate-900' for headings and 'text-slate-600' for body text on light backgrounds.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, and cards.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'Bootstrap' looks. Use generous padding (p-8+).
Never use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-900 or Blue-950.
Buttons must be pill-shaped (rounded-full) for a modern app feel.
Use 'backdrop-blur' for sticky headers and overlays.
Forms should be split into steps if they have more than 4 fields.
